scope: Static audit only; does not change benchmark inputs or historical results.
specification_status: Local saved competition specification. Exact official converter/tokenization was not supplied.
interpretation: One add corresponds to an ordered chunk inside a session. It is not one question, one turn pair, or the full sample.
The four samples have 200 sessions and 204 chunks. Only four additional chunks come from threshold splitting.
Doubling both local thresholds would reduce 204 chunks to 200 without crossing sessions, but would change the stated ingestion policy; this is not an approved benchmark configuration.
The large fixed cost per synchronous add and process-wide single-lane generation are implementation choices, not requirements to use multiple model passes.
remaining_questions: Exact official session conversion and approximately-2000-word counting algorithm.
